goal: Allow kernel consumers to validate blocks against caller-provided coins without maintaining a local UTXO set
Enable lightweight verifiers and external UTXO backends to validate blocks directly via libbitcoinkernel
agreement: Contested design around callback-based coin lookups and cache safety
Support for enabling external coin validation and the callback model (ismaelsadeeq, alexanderwiederin)
Contested objection: caller callback allows non-deterministic lookups and drops UTXO changes (ajtowns)
Contested objection: script cache poisoning could allow forged coins to connect invalid blocks (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: blocks below assumevalid skip script checks with no override (nervana21, pzafonte)
Unaddressed objection: invoking caller callbacks under cs_main blocks other kernel calls on I/O (pzafonte)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it expands the C API so external applications can validate blocks without local chainstate
Unblocks lightweight verifiers and alternative UTXO storage engines built on libbitcoinkernel

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it adds a check-only block validation entry point interacting with consensus caching invariants
Impact is moderate as it affects kernel consumers without altering standard node block connection
